subject: Re: Elara Order Form draft — pricing schedule & tax appendix
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@elarahealth.com>

Cc: Elara Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elara: draft Order Form (pricing schedule + tax appendix)
Attachments: elara_orderform_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Alex — attaching our updated Order Form draft. A few open items we need you and legal to confirm so procurement can route a PO: 

1) Invoicing entity — we currently have the invoice routed to Elara Health, Inc. (US entity). Can you confirm Redwood will accept billing to that entity and whether Redwood requires any subsidiary mapping?

2) VAT / sales tax — for our EU usage we asked our tax team to include the EU VAT reverse-charge on the invoice. Can Redwood accept a reverse-charge flow if we provide VAT registration? If not, what evidence do you need?

3) Minimum commit ramp — we moved the ramp to 50% / 75% / 100% across the first three quarters. We need to confirm activation/prorated invoicing for the first quarter.

4) PO reference — procurement will issue PO #6542 once billing entity and net terms are finalized.

Please loop in anyone on your side who needs to see the redlines. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Head of Procurement
Elara Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@elarahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Elara: draft Order Form (pricing schedule + tax appendix)
Attachments: redlines_alex_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the draft and the clear list. Quick summary and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Invoicing entity: Redwood can bill Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) to start. If Elara needs split invoicing to another legal entity, we will need the legal entity name and tax ID for that entity before execution.

- VAT / sales tax: I’ve attached my redlines with the ask to confirm whether you can provide an EU VAT registration number. If you can provide it, we can accept reverse-charge for EU invoices (we’ll need the certificate + billing contact). Otherwise our standard flow is to invoice gross and reverse-charge will not be applied.

- Minimum commit ramp & activation: We can prorate the activation fee for the initial quarter and align billing to the ramp percentages you shared. We’ll need the final ramp table in the Order Form appendix.

- Net terms & PO: Our standard is Net 30. If procurement needs Net 45 or a different cadence, I’ll need a manager/legal ok. Once net terms and entity are locked we can accept PO #6542.

Next steps: 
1) Kim (cc) — can legal confirm acceptance of reverse-charge with documentation and any suggested MSA language?
2) Marissa (cc) — can you confirm whether team is okay to move to Net 45 for this deal if procurement insists?
3) Sophie — if you send over the VAT reg + final ramp table I’ll fold into the redline doc and push for a signature link.

Happy to take a 20-min sync if helpful — available later today.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0124

On Mon, Jun 15, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@elarahealth.com> wrote:
> Alex — attaching our updated Order Form draft. A few open items we need you and legal to confirm so procurement can route a PO: 
> 
> 1) Invoicing entity — we currently have the invoice routed to Elara Health, Inc. (US entity). Can you confirm Redwood will accept billing to that entity and whether Redwood requires any subsidiary mapping?
> 
> 2) VAT / sales tax — for our EU usage we asked our tax team to include the EU VAT reverse-charge on the invoice. Can Redwood accept a reverse-charge flow if we provide VAT registration? If not, what evidence do you need?

Thanks for the context. A few legal notes and suggested redlines: 

- VAT / reverse-charge: We can accept reverse-charge for EU-supplied services provided Elara supplies a valid VAT registration number for the billed entity and a certificate of tax status. Inserted clause: "Customer will provide proof of VAT registration and any required tax residency documentation; absent timely proof, Vendor may invoice gross and Customer is responsible for any taxes." 

- Net terms: Given the ramping nature and standard Redwood practice, we prefer to hold to Net 30. However, I'm amenable to Net 45 if Sales confirms commercial approval (Marissa). If Net 45 is required, we should add an interest/late fee clause or a short-term credit hold trigger (standard language in my redlines).

- Minimum commits & termination: I recommend we keep a soft remediation milestone rather than immediate termination for early underperformance. Suggested language: "Customer will have a 60-day cure period following the end of each quarter where minimum usage was not met; failure to cure permits Vendor to suspend services or adjust pricing on a prospective basis." 

- Invoicing entity mapping: We require legal entity name + tax ID to map invoices. If Elara needs invoices to multiple entities, each entity must be listed in the Order Form appendix.

I’ve put tracked changes into the MSA / Order Form PDF (redlines_alex_v1.pdf). From Legal’s perspective we also need to collect documentation for any EU reverse-charge claim before accepting net-term liability.

K
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kim and Alex — helpful. A few notes from Procurement after a quick run-through: 

- VAT: We can provide the EU VAT registration for Elara EU Services, and I attached the initial proof of registration. Will follow up with the full certificate this afternoon.

- Net terms: Procurement prefers Net 45 given our internal AP cycles. If Redwood is able to accept Net 45 we will issue PO #6542 immediately upon final Order Form sign.

- Ramp table: Confirmed — we will send the final ramp spreadsheet with the quarter-by-quarter targets; we expect the activation fee to be prorated to the quarter start date.

Can you confirm whether a single invoicing entity (Elara Health, Inc.) is sufficient? If Redwood needs separate entity lines for EU, we will provide entity tax IDs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sophie Lane
Head of Procurement
Elara Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elara: draft Order Form (pricing schedule + tax appendix)

Alex / Kim — reviewed. Executive decisions for this opportunity (ELR-2026-117):

1) Net terms concession: Approved to move to Net 45 for this deal only, subject to PO #6542 being received and a Salesforce flag set for Net45 concessions. Add the late fee trigger Kim suggested.

2) VAT / reverse-charge: Accept reverse-charge if Elara provides VAT registration + certificate before first EU invoice. If documentation is not provided within 14 days of execution, Redwood will invoice gross and collect taxes.

3) Minimum commit ramp: Approve prorated activation fee and the proposed 3-quarter ramp (50% / 75% / 100%). Legal to include the 60-day cure period language, not immediate termination.

4) Invoicing entity: Accept single invoicing to Elara Health, Inc. for US billing. If Elara requires EU entity invoicing, include those entities in the appendix with tax IDs prior to invoice issuance.

Alex — proceed to update the Order Form with the agreed redlines, get signatures, and route the DocuSign link to procurement. Capture PO #6542 on the DocuSign cover page. Please close the loop and paste the DocuSign link in HubSpot under the deal record.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference
